scenarios.description: Verifies basic Windows Debug startup: restore, build, test, launch, process observation, window presence, startup event detection, and clean shutdown. No rendered interactions or button clicks.

scenarios.displayName: Import, definition lookup, and full reset
scenarios.description: Imports a short German text in Definition mode, confirms the review workflow advanced, then resets all application data from Settings and confirms Home returns to the empty state.

Opens the Other meaning picker on a deterministically seeded candidate, selects a non-default meaning, accepts it with the real Accept button, and proves the workflow advances and the isolated database persists exactly the selected Sense and Meaning.

Injects a deterministic single-shot in-transaction acceptance failure and proves the page stays usable with an inline save error, the acceptance rolls back completely, and a retry succeeds and advances.

Seeds a candidate carrying a misattributed occurrence and proves the misattributed context is never rendered, the candidate is still acceptable, and neither a blank page nor the global ErrorBoundary appears.
